quizzes.title: MCAS · Speed & velocity
quizzes.focus: After average speed, average velocity, elapsed time, and return trips.

questions.prompt:
MCAS 2016 · Question 5
Choose one answer from the original question.
questions.guide: Teacher-draft solution: average speed is a scalar with magnitude only; average velocity has magnitude and direction. Award 1 point for D.

questions.prompt:
MCAS 2015 · Question 20
Choose one answer from the original question.
questions.guide: Teacher-draft solution: total distance = 200 × 4.0 = 800 km. Average speed = 800 / 190 ≈ 4.2 km/min. Award 1 point for D.

questions.prompt:
MCAS 2013 · Question 32
Respond to every labeled part. Use the drawing tools where a graph or model is requested.
questions.guide: Teacher-draft rubric, 4 points: (a) 1200 m / 1080 s ≈ 1.11 m/s, or 66.7 m/min, with calculation and units (1); (b) equal average-velocity magnitudes but opposite directions: south outbound and north returning (1); (c) total distance 2400 m (1); (d) final displacement 0 m because the student returns to the starting position (1). Accept equivalent units and reasonable rounding.

MCAS 2004 · Question 8
Respond to every labeled part. Use the drawing tools where a graph or model is requested.
questions.guide: Teacher-draft rubric, 4 points: (a) label time (s) horizontally and position (m) vertically with a consistent scale (1), and plot (0,75), (10,125), (20,175), (30,225), (40,275) on a straight line (1); (b) average speed = (275 − 75) m / 40 s = 5 m/s (1); (c) acceleration is zero because the velocity/slope remains constant (1).
